description: This file defines the ItemAdapter class, a RecyclerView.Adapter implementation for managing and displaying a list of items, including notes and section headers in an Android notes app. It handles different view types (section headers, notes with/without excerpt, title-only notes), multi-selection, theming, and binding data to view holders.

classes.name: ItemAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView.Adapter subclass that manages a list of items (notes and sections), handles different view types, selection, and theming.

methods.name: ItemAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, grid view mode, and configuration such as font size and color.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item at a given position, differentiating sections and notes.

methods.name: setItemList
methods.description: Updates the internal item list and refreshes the view.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holders based on the item view type and view mode (grid/list).

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to view holders, manages selection state, and visual updates.

methods.name: setTracker
methods.description: Associates a SelectionTracker for managing multi-selection.

methods.name: isMultiSelect
methods.description: Returns whether multi-selection mode is active.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves an item at a specific position.

methods.name: hasItemPosition
methods.description: Checks if the position is within bounds.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the list.

methods.name: setShowCategory
methods.description: Sets whether to display category labels.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of items.

methods.name: getItemViewType
methods.description: Determines the view type for an item based on its properties.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies a color theme to the adapter.

methods.name: setHighlightSearchQuery
methods.description: Highlights search terms in displayed items.

methods.name: getFirstPositionOfViewType
methods.description: Finds first position of a specific view type.

methods.name: getSwipedPosition
methods.description: Returns the position of an item that is swiped, if any.

methods.name: setSwipedPosition
methods.description: Sets the swiped position for swipe actions.
